text: The share capital of Prima Assicurazioni is held 48% by Teodoro D'Ambrosio, 27% by Blackstone, 15% by Goldman Sachs, 8% by top management and 2% by Carlyle, as reported by Milano Finanza in February 2025.
short: Prima Assicurazioni: D'Ambrosio 48%, Blackstone 27%, Goldman Sachs 15%, management 8%, Carlyle 2% (Feb 2025)

source.name: Milano Finanza: Polizze, ora Prima Assicurazioni fa gola ai big
source.quote: il top management all'8%, Blackstone e Goldman Sachs rispettivamente al 27% e al 15%, Carlyle al 2%, mentre il restante 48% è nelle mani di Teodoro D'Ambrosio
source.note: Translation: the current shareholding sees top management at 8%, Blackstone and Goldman Sachs at 27% and 15% respectively, Carlyle at 2%, and the remaining 48% in the hands of Teodoro D'Ambrosio.
